    How to Use the Team Name Generator

    Pick a theme, choose how many names you want, from 1 to 10, and tap Generate names. Each name has its own Copy button, or use Copy all for the whole list. Nothing you like? Generate more swaps in a fresh batch.

    How the names are made

    Each name is one adjective plus one noun, picked at random from a list for that theme: 30 of each, so every theme can make hundreds of different names. Gaming leans dramatic (Shadow Wolves), Trivia leans nerdy (Brainy Owls), Sports sounds like a real team (Golden Hawks), Work pokes fun at the office (Reply-All Rockstars), and Silly is just silly (Soggy Waffles). No name repeats within a batch.

    The words are picked with your browser's secure random number generator. The word lists are part of the page, so nothing is looked up online and nothing is saved.

    Ways to use it

    • Gaming squads and clans. Something better than "Team 1".
    • Trivia night. A name for the answer sheet before the first round.
    • Fantasy sports. A starting point you can tweak into a pun.
    • Work team-building. The Work theme is in on the joke.
    • Youth groups and camps. Silly names go over well with kids.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    How are the names made?

    Each name is a random adjective plus a random noun from the theme's word list, like "Neon Krakens" or "Fluffy Burritos". Every theme has 30 adjectives and 30 nouns.

    Can I pick a theme?

    Yes: Gaming, Trivia, Sports, Work or Silly. Switching themes switches the word lists.

    How many names can I generate at once?

    From 1 to 10. Names in the same batch never repeat. Tap Generate more for a new batch.

    Can I copy a name?

    Yes. Every name has its own Copy button, and Copy all copies the whole list, one name per line.

    Is anything saved?

    No. The names are made in your browser and nothing is saved or sent anywhere.
